targets.expr: sum by (pod) (rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{container="ovn-controller",k8s_cluster_name=~"$cluster",namespace="ovn-kubernetes",pod=~"$pod"}[5m])) and topk($topk, sum by (pod) (rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{container="ovn-controller",k8s_cluster_name=~"$cluster",namespace="ovn-kubernetes",pod=~"$pod"}[$__range] @ end())))

panels.title: CPU Usage (Top K)
panels.description: CPU usage of container ovn-controller. Only the $topk pods with the highest average usage over the selected time range are shown.

targets.expr: sum by (pod) (container_memory_working_set_bytes{container="ovn-controller",k8s_cluster_name=~"$cluster",namespace="ovn-kubernetes",pod=~"$pod"}) / 1024 ^ 3 and topk($topk, sum by (pod) (avg_over_time(container_memory_working_set_bytes{container="ovn-controller",k8s_cluster_name=~"$cluster",namespace="ovn-kubernetes",pod=~"$pod"}[$__range] @ end())) / 1024 ^ 3)

panels.title: Memory Usage (Top K)
panels.description: Working set memory usage of container ovn-controller. Only the $topk pods with the highest average usage over the selected time range are shown.

targets.expr: sum by (pod) (rate(kube_pod_container_status_restarts_total{container="ovn-controller",k8s_cluster_name=~"$cluster",namespace="ovn-kubernetes",pod=~"$pod"}[5m])) and topk($topk, sum by (pod) (rate(kube_pod_container_status_restarts_total{container="ovn-controller",k8s_cluster_name=~"$cluster",namespace="ovn-kubernetes",pod=~"$pod"}[$__range] @ end())))

panels.title: Logical Flow Translate Rate (Top K)
panels.description: The rate of translating the Logical_Flow table in the OVN SB database into OpenFlow flows.

options.content:
Each performance counter has below stats:
Counter Description
95th_percentile The 95th percentile of execution times.
maximum The maximum (worst-case) execution time observed across all samples.
minimum The minimum (best-case) execution time observed across all samples.
short_term_avg Uses an Exponentially Weighted Moving Average (alpha=0.50) for a smoothed average that quickly reflects recent changes by weighting newer samples more heavily.
long_term_avg A stable, long-term average is calculated using an Exponentially Weighted Moving Average with alpha=0.01, making it less sensitive to recent fluctuations.
total_samples Total number of measurements recorded by the stopwatch.
